description.value: 💡This handmade wood pendant light combines contemporary industrial design with a mid-century modern feeling. What is so unique about this lamp is the fact that it creates streams of shadow and light on the ceiling and walls. The stronger the light, the bigger the casting shadows.☂UMBRELLA has everything you need to change your whole home decor. With its mid-century design and warm illumination, this light fixture is the ideal accent to any living area, creating a comfortable and welcoming ambiance.  Let yourself be inspired! Just choose your favorite design and start updating your interior today!❕All umbrella pendant lights come with gold pins, which convey a refined finish and a touch of luxury.Each of our wood chandelier lights comes with our handmade wooden ceiling cup. A picture of our ceiling cup has been listed in the picture section for you to have a closer look at. We aim to provide a full Dezaart experience to our customers. 👉Looking for a pendant light that's stylish, modern, and unique? We also have a selection of on-trend patterns, like floral, stripes, and geometric, in a wide variety of colors and textures, suiting every style and place.https://www.etsy.com/listing/1611419239/scandinavian-wood-pendant-light-modern ♻All our wood light fixtures have been carefully created by us, in our family workshop in Greece, using sustainable wood and promoting environmentally friendly practices, helping to protect forests, reduce deforestation, and combat climate change.- - - -📏 DIMENSIONS - - - -Height / Diameter►Small Size : 8in x 19in  /  20cm x 48 cm►Large Size : 12in x 23in  / 29cm x 58 cmEach of our wood chandelier lighting comes with our own handmade black ceiling cup, which provides a full Dezaart experience to our customers.► Ceiling Cup Dimensions: 14cm (5.6in)- - - -🛠 ASSEMBLE - - - -Assembly is required! Your pendant light will be shipped with fully detailed instructions on how to assemble it. No glue or screws are needed, and it can be done in just 5-10 minutes. The reason for this is safer transportation and cheaper shipping costs for the buyerYouTube tutorial on assembling and adjusting the pendant light, ceiling cup, and cord here:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00IsxP-cYtEhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zBPVQchr170- - - -💡 INSTALATTION - - - -Up to 60W lamp holder voltage: E27 / E26110-220V comes with a 1m (40in) cordLIGHT BULB NOT INCLUDED!► We can accommodate a plug-in version, with a longer or shorter cord.You just have to leave a note in the comment section of your order.Up to 3 meters is free of charge for every extra meter, plus 5 euros.- - - -✈ Shipping & Returns -  -  -  -  SHIPPING TO USA, CANADA AND EUROPE WITH TRACKING NUMBEREU: 3-5 working daysUSA, UK, CANADA, AUSTRALIA: 5-7 working days (we do our best to prepare your order, and we are not responsible for any delays that might occur from extended customs clearance times, Christmas, etc )******For the USA/ UK/Canada/ Australia, and other countries, you are charged with the necessary taxes and duties. Unfortunately, this is unavoidable. Please always check your local regulations when you proceed with your order. *******►►►❗The CUSTOMER is responsible for the RETURNING COST and any possible IMPORT or CUSTOM DUTIES.So please, keep in mind and be sure of your purchase, and for the color, dimensions, or any further details of our products.We are here to help you so as to make the right choice!  ❕If something is wrong with the product, please do not hesitate to contact usImmediately, we will resolve any problems that might occur.We value your feedback.👉If you are interested in WHOLESALE please inform us.We are eager to hear your proposals!
